name: fixtures-onsat-web-api
description: Web reconstruction of the Fixtures ONSAT app plus a reusable, provider-agnostic football fixtures & broadcast-channels REST API.

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w backend & npm run dev -w frontend
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
